rows: The Deploy of that lockfile change (run 37974249978, head `42b1161`) rebuilt both service images: `plan` 19 s, `deploy (remote-chat-agent)` 1 min 43 s, `deploy (leetcode-backend)` 1 min 7 s, Metro skipped, 3 min 17 s end to end from the push, all green (the legs run one after the other on the one runner; the dependency cache mounts were warm, the changed crate and everything that depends on it compiled again). It is the worst warm case for the five-minute target: a change that invalidates the dependency layer of both Rust images; a cold cache fill (about 15 min) is the only slower case measured.
